sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 15:14

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 15:14:1
items.html: The fourth is that she too serves in one Keter like him, and receives her lights from Ima herself, not through ZA, like AVI; and she will be complete in all ten Sefirot, and this is the limit of her growth. And it has already been explained that this fourth phase does not apply in this time in the great ZON, but in the small ZON alone. Study it there well. And as long as she needs to receive from ZA she lacks her Malchut, as above. And this is what he says, that only through her reception from Ima, not through ZA, is she completed in ten Sefirot; for then she receives the light also into her Malchut, as above.
